objective: Independently review the updated D1 phase coordinator readback and D1.6 clean-source reproduction evidence against the development-readiness plan. Decide whether D1.6's clean-checkout manual criterion is now met, verify D1.1-D1.5 evidence boundaries and D1/D2 scope, and return a recommendation with factual discrepancies. Do not accept D1.6, check plan boxes, update current-state/catalog/recipes, publish, open a PR, or merge.
interface_contract: Return an independent recommendation only. The coordinator retains D1.6 and D1 acceptance authority. A passing fresh local clone of committed parent source with exact submodule fetches may satisfy the D1 manual criterion; do not infer parent GitHub cloning, hosted Actions, Windows, clean-image macOS, bare-metal Linux, hidden-oracle isolation, or release readiness.
steps: Read the bound context and verify its hashes; compare the coordinator readback with the authoritative D1 plan and current-state.
Inspect all 19 clean-source command receipts and their local logs. Verify parent SHA, Kairos and Conductor pin SHAs, configured Kairos origin, clean status, exact test totals and command outputs.
Check the publication record, historical hold, D1.1-D1.5 reconciliations, and that residual hosted/platform claims stay explicitly unverified.
Run the exact planning verification commands and record actual timestamps, exit codes, output hashes and tool versions in the result/receipt.
Write a concise independent proposal in the reserved path. Recommend accept or hold and name any factual discrepancy or unresolved gate; do not alter status records.

verification.oracle: All active track links and current-state context paths resolve with no errors.
The task catalog still covers all tasks with a valid prerequisite DAG.
MVP parent/leaf coverage, joins, context hashes and objective hashes remain valid.

acceptance: Every factual claim is supported by a bound source or current command output.
The recommendation explicitly assesses whether fresh configured-source reproduction satisfies D1's manual criterion.
D1.4 small-sample and hidden-oracle limits, D1.5 synthetic recovery/single-coordinator limits, and D2 hosted/release gates remain intact.
No plan checkbox, current-state acceptance, task catalog, MVP recipe or remote repository state is changed.
stop_conditions: Any bound input hash or base commit has drifted
Clean-source logs are missing or contradict the JSON receipt
A material D1.1-D1.5 discrepancy or unresolved D1 exit criterion is found
Requested write falls outside the reserved proposal/result/receipt paths
